title: TGrasp6D: Task-Informed Vision-Language Priors and Pose Refinement enable Zero-Shot Task-Oriented 6DoF Grasping
abstract: arXiv:2610.20901v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Task-Oriented Grasping (TOG) has emerged as an important skill for purposeful robotic manipulation. Given the task of using a knife to "slice bread," a robot must choose to grasp from the handle, whereas for "hand[ing] the knife over," it is preferable for the handle to remain unobstructed for safe handoff. Current approaches for TOG either focus on 2D planar grasping, remain limited by their reliance on task-agnostic grasp generators, or are constrained by reliance on finite, manually-annotated, task-specific grasp datasets that cannot cover all possible grasp-task pairs. To that end, we present TGrasp6D, a vision-language based approach for generating task-oriented 6DoF grasps in a zero-shot manner. Given a task and a single RGB-D image of an associated object, TGrasp6D reasons about the appropriate semantic affordance for the given task and object geometry to produce an initial task- informed prior. translated_title: TGrasp6D：任务感知的视觉-语言先验与位姿优化实现零样本面向任务的6自由度抓取
translated_abstract: 面向任务抓取已成为机器人有目的性操作的一项重要技能。例如，在“用刀切面包”的任务中，机器人必须选择抓握刀柄；而在“把刀递给别人”的任务中，则最好保持刀柄不被遮挡，以便安全交接。当前的面向任务抓取方法要么局限于二维平面抓取，要么受限于依赖与任务无关的抓取生成器，要么依赖于有限的、人工标注的、特定任务的抓取数据集，而这些数据集无法覆盖所有可能的抓取-任务组合。为此，我们提出了TGrasp6D，一种基于视觉-语言的方法，能够以零样本方式生成面向任务的6自由度抓取。给定一项任务和目标物体的一张RGB-D图像，TGrasp6D会针对给定任务和物体几何结构推理出合适的语义可供性，从而产生初始的任务感知先验。该生成的先验进一步……
tldr: 该论文提出TGrasp6D，一种基于视觉-语言模型的零样本面向任务6自由度抓取方法，通过推理任务相关的语义先验并结合位姿优化，摆脱了对有限人工标注任务特定抓取数据集的依赖。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TGrasp6D, a zero-shot task-oriented 6DoF grasping method that leverages vision-language reasoning to generate task-informed semantic priors combined with pose refinement, eliminating reliance on finite, manually-annotated, task-specific grasp datasets.
